Markets.title: Bond market turmoil puts Fed Rate decision under spotlight
Markets.summary: A global bond market selloff has intensified focus on the Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision as investors debate whether to hike rates or pause. Growing concerns over persistent inflation, rising oil prices, and high Treasury yields are driving up long-term borrowing costs.

Markets.title: Paytm shares drop 3% after govt shields UPI payments only up to Rs 2,000 from charges. Should you buy the dip?
Markets.summary: Paytm shares dropped 3% after the Indian government barred banks and payment providers from charging fees on UPI transactions up to 2,000 rupees. This ruling creates uncertainty regarding potential fees for higher-value UPI transactions, following the stock's recent surge to a 52-week high.

Markets.title: Is unlisted investing a lottery? The story of a NSE investor who bought shares at Rs 1,827
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange's upcoming IPO price band of Rs 1,700 to Rs 1,785 falls below previous unlisted-market expectations. This pricing serves as a reality check for investors who previously bought the exchange's unlisted shares at higher prices, such as Rs 1,827.

Markets.title: Solar Industries shares crash 9% after acquisition of South Africa’s Omnia Holdings for Rs 12,951 crore
Markets.summary: Solar Industries shares dropped 9 percent following the company's announcement of an all-cash acquisition of South Africa's Omnia Holdings for Rs 12,951 crore. The pending transaction aims to expand the company's global explosives and blasting business across Africa and international markets.

Markets.title: How to trade HDFC Bank shares? Here’s what technical analysts are saying as lender hunts for new CEO
Markets.summary: HDFC Bank shares rose after the lender submitted two candidates to the RBI to succeed CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan. Technical analysts noted that the stock has faced sustained pressure this year while highlighting key resistance levels and management continuity as important triggers.

Markets.title: Hero Motors IPO opens tomorrow; GMP signals 29% potential listing upside. Check key details
Markets.summary: Hero Motors' Rs 1,000-crore IPO opens on September 16 with a price band of Rs 79 to Rs 84 per share. The grey market premium suggests a potential 27% listing gain, while the funds will be used for debt repayment, capacity expansion, and acquisitions.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says AI safety fears a 'hoax' as he rejects calls for greater safeguards
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump dismissed artificial intelligence safety fears as a hoax and rejected calls for stricter regulations. His comments followed a warning from Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark that governments may need to mandate an AI "kill switch."

Geo-Political.title: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win

Geo-Political.title: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace
Geo-Political.summary: NATO fighter jets shot down an unidentified drone that entered Lithuanian airspace. Authorities stated the drone likely originated from neighboring Belarus, which is an ally of Russia.

Geo-Political.title: US confirms for first time it has deployed space weapons
Geo-Political.summary: The US Air Force Secretary has confirmed for the first time that the United States has deployed space weapons. Officials stated that these weapons are necessary to defend the country against potential enemy action.

Geo-Political.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
Geo-Political.summary: Three male wild dogs in Zambia traveled a record-breaking 2,500 miles searching for a mate. Scientists state this extraordinary journey demonstrates that wildlife can still survive despite increasing environmental pressures.

Geo-Political.title: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87

Data & Insights.title: Why reducing govt debt matters for India even when it’s lower than advanced economies
Data & Insights.summary: India must reduce its public debt to maintain investor trust, despite having lower debt levels than advanced economies. This is necessary due to the country's high interest-to-revenue burden and strict market expectations for emerging markets.

Data & Insights.title: Rising inflation sparks buzz of early rate hike
Data & Insights.summary: Two key inflation indicators have increased at the same time, signaling growing price pressures throughout the economy. This economic shift is generating speculation that interest rates might be raised earlier than expected.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation breaches RBl's midpoint target for third successive month
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to a 20-month high of 4.82% in August due to high food and fuel prices. This marks the third consecutive month that inflation has breached the Reserve Bank of India's midpoint target.

Data & Insights.title: Wholesale price inflation nears double digits in August; next month may be worse
Data & Insights.summary: Wholesale price inflation remained near double digits in August, and next month's inflation is expected to worsen. Because businesses pass rising input costs on to consumers, the Reserve Bank of India closely monitors these wholesale price pressures alongside its retail inflation targets.

Data & Insights.title: Trump says US should have world’s lowest interest rates ahead of Fed meeting: ‘I know more about formulas’
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of the Federal Reserve's September meeting, Donald Trump urged the United States to adopt the world's lowest interest rates despite rising inflation and oil prices. Meanwhile, officials stated that Trump would defend Fed nominee Kevin Warsh's independence.

Data & Insights.title: Rate hikes are back? Kevin Warsh and G7 central banks face inflation test this week
Data & Insights.summary: This week, the US Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and Bank of Japan will announce critical interest rate decisions. These choices will test central banks against inflation and could reshape the global monetary policy outlook for 2026 and beyond.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | No, Sydney Sweeney. A Naked Woman Isn't Some Great 'Revolution'
India.summary: An opinion piece argues that advertisers using a naked woman to sell products is not a revolutionary act of empowerment. The author distinguishes this practice from an athlete choosing to embrace her own sexuality.

India.title: JEE To NEET: 400 Students Get Expert Exam Preparation Tips At IIT Kanpur Summit
India.summary: IIT Kanpur hosted a summit providing expert exam preparation tips to 400 students for entrance tests like JEE and NEET. The event aimed to help aspiring candidates improve their preparation strategies for these competitive engineering and medical exams.

India.title: Gurugram Hit-And-Run Accused Kalyan Bainsla Detained, 'Attempt To Murder' Invoked
India.summary: Gurugram Police detained Kalyan Bainsla in connection with a hit-and-run incident. Authorities added an attempt to murder charge against the driver based on CCTV evidence.

India.title: 362 Metric Tonnes Of Pak Dates Hidden Behind UAE Labels Seized In Maharashtra
India.summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence seized over 362 metric tonnes of Pakistani dry dates in Maharashtra. The goods were falsely labeled as originating from the UAE to bypass import bans on Pakistani products.

India.title: Delhi To Rishikesh In 2.5 Hours, Karnaprayag In 5: New Rail Link Through 105 km Of Tunnels
India.summary: A proposed Namo Bharat rail extension could reduce travel time from Delhi to Rishikesh to approximately 2.5 hours. The new network would feature 105 kilometers of tunnels and also connect Delhi to Karnaprayag in five hours.

India.title: Meta says will report child safety cases directly to Indian cybercrime portal
India.summary: Meta is the first major tech company to commit to reporting child safety cases directly to India's cybercrime portal. This creates a direct reporting pipeline between the U.S.-headquartered firm and Indian law enforcement.

General.title: State pension likely to rise by £488 a year in April
General.summary: The state pension is expected to increase by £488 a year starting in April. This adjustment is determined by the highest of wage growth, inflation, or the 2.5% guarantee.
